question: Does the recall-first v5 relevance instruction improve the production Jev news screen over v4?
transport: Production agents.jev_relevance.JevRelevanceFilter -> TypeSafeAdapter -> https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone, model jev-1.13.0, one request per day (chunk_size 128). Policy object swapped per arm; config identical.

v4.instruction: You are a bounded news relevance adjudicator. Judge only the supplied title, source, and snippet. Use relevant when the bounded evidence is about an AI/ML model, company, product, research, safety, policy, infrastructure, controversy, or other substantive AI news; use irrelevant when it is outside that scope; use insufficient_evidence when the evidence cannot support either call.

v5.instruction: You are a news relevance adjudicator for a daily AI news digest. Judge only the supplied title, source, and snippet. Use relevant when the title or snippet is about artificial intelligence or machine learning in a way a reader following AI news would want to see: models, companies, products, research, safety, policy, regulation, politics, public statements about AI, infrastructure, business, or controversy. AI does not have to be the whole story if it is a clear subject of the headline or snippet. Use irrelevant only when AI is absent or merely incidental. Use insufficient_evidence when the evidence cannot support either call.

design: 3 paired runs per arm; arm order alternated per run. Historical cohort = the 537 frozen September 8-17 inputs from data/shadow-review/choice-critical-2026-09-17; today = the 81 records of the actual 2026-09-23 production Jev request (web/data/2026-09-23/replay-prompts.json.gz, call c001). Keep = effective_keep (relevant or insufficient_evidence or fallback).
reference_labels: DeepSeek v4.1 Flash judge labels (456 relevant / 79 irrelevant / 2 insufficient after the two user-reviewed editorial overrides; 454/81/2 unedited). Judge labels are model estimates, not ground truth. 168 judge-important stories.
